queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'DYMO ID' AND publisher = 'Sanford, L.P.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'DYMO ID' AND publisher = 'Sanford, L.P.' AND version_compare(version, '1.5.1.71') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'dymo id.exe');
